entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: I saw that new transfer student[n]hanging out with Sakamoto-kun.[n]The two of them are so scary...

entries.speaker: Female Student Heading Home
entries.en: He doesn't look like the kind of[n]guy who'd have a criminal record.[n]Maybe he's one of those?

entries.speaker: Female Student Heading Home
entries.en: You know, the people in those[n]accidents. Maybe he suddenly[n]freaks out and attacks people.

entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: Huh? I don't think so. He's just[n]been coming to school. Actually,[n]he almost seems normal.

entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: And from what I hear, after you[n]have a psychotic breakdown, you[n]go brain dead and die right there.

entries.speaker: Scared Female Student
entries.en: He won't attack anyone in school,[n]will he? Someone told me he hides[n]knives in his clothes...

entries.en: Sakamoto's been asking questions[n]about the volleyball team. Just who[n]does he think he is?

entries.speaker: Shujin Student Heading Home
entries.en: Well, if Kamoshida likes them,[n]their future is pretty much set.[n]Of course they'd back him up.

entries.speaker: Shujin Student Heading Home
entries.en: Speaking of which, I hear[n]Kamoshida's new favorite girl[n]is someone named Suzui.

entries.speaker: Carefree Shujin Student
entries.en: Oh, the girl who was chosen to[n]be a regular? Ah, her face was[n]all swollen. It looked pretty bad.

entries.speaker: Carefree Shujin Student
entries.en: She's probably just letting all the[n]pressure get to her. Well, we don't[n]really know her, so...

entries.speaker: Gossipy Female Student
entries.en: Takamaki always looks kind of unhappy[n]whenever Mr. Kamoshida talks to her.

entries.speaker: Rude Female Student
entries.en: Maybe she doesn't wanna talk to him at[n]school to show off how she's got him[n]wrapped around her finger? Ugh... Gross.
